note: Elbert County, GA publishes its parcel map only through the Schneider qPublic web viewer; no public ArcGIS REST parcel service found. The county Hub site serves only Elbert County, Colorado data. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no county-run Georgia parcel Feature Service. Georgia GIO hub and GIS Clearinghouse list no free Elbert parcel download; only commercial vendors (Regrid, MappingSolutionsGIS) offer it. qPublic returns a bot-check (HTTP 403), so it cannot be queried as a service.
